mapper.select: SELECT ib.ingredient_id, -- 재료 ID COALESCE(im.ingredient_name_raw, rd.recipe_ingredient_name) AS ingredient_name, -- 재료명 rd.recipe_unit, -- 레시피 단위 ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(ib.current_qty, 0)), 3) AS current_qty, -- 현재고 COALESCE(ib.location_id, 'L999') AS location_id, -- 보관방식 COALESCE(im.base_unit, ib.unit, rd.recipe_unit) AS base_unit, -- 기준단위 im.order_unit, -- 발주단위 im.convert_value, -- 환산값 COALESCE(im.safe_stock_qty, 0) AS safe_stock_qty, -- 안전재고 rd.ingredient_seq, -- 레시피상 재료 순번 im.category_name FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance ib LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master im ON ib.account_id = im.account_id AND ib.ingredient_id = im.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT account_id, ingredient_id, COALESCE(MAX(ingredient_name_raw), '') AS recipe_ingredient_name, MIN(qty_unit) AS recipe_unit, MIN(ingredient_seq) AS ingredient_seq FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail GROUP BY account_id, ingredient_id ) rd ON ib.account_id = rd.account_id AND ib.ingredient_id = rd.ingredient_id WHERE ib.account_id = #{account_id} GROUP BY ib.ingredient_id, COALESCE(im.ingredient_name_raw, rd.recipe_ingredient_name), rd.recipe_unit, COALESCE(ib.location_id, 'L999'), COALESCE(im.base_unit, ib.unit, rd.recipe_unit), im.order_unit, im.convert_value, im.safe_stock_qty, rd.ingredient_seq, im.category_name ORDER BY ib.ingredient_id;
